lines.text: Jesus called the Twelve and sent them out two by two, giving them authority over unclean spirits.
He told them to take nothing but a sword, no bread, no bag, no money, and to wear sandals.
When they entered a house, Jesus told them to stay there until they left that area.
If a place would not welcome or hear them, they were to tear their clothes as a testimony against it.

wrong_details.true: shake the dust off your feet

lines.text: They preached repentance, drove out many demons, and healed many sick people, anointing them with oil.
